newsitem.title: USA: FGIC says GICs unaffected by money market shift.
newsitem.headline: FGIC says GICs unaffected by money market shift.

text.p: Financial Guaranty Insurance Co said Wednesday its guaranteed investment contract business was not affected by recent moves out of the money market fund business.

FGIC, a unit of General Electric Co's GE Capital Services, said reports about its decision to dissolve a unit handling money market fund investments for government entities had created confusion about its GIC operation.

FGIC said in a statement it continues to manage about $3.5 billion of guaranteed investment contracts for state and local governments, agencies, and related entities under its FGIC Capital Markets Services Trinity and Trinity Plus units.

The operation was not affected by the company's decision to dissolve its FGIC Advisors unit, which handled short-term investments in money market funds for government entities. The shift included moving about $300 million from the money market funds to GE's GE Investment Management Inc unit.
